title: Cartoon
makes: A short cartoon of any character you describe; the character speaks and acts in each scene.

ask_first.ask: What is the character? Describe it: what kind of creature or thing, shape, colours, face, what it wears.
Do you have a picture of it? (optional; one is drawn from your description if not)
What kind of cartoon is it? (for example a children's counting cartoon)
Where does it happen? (optional; a simple bright place is invented if you leave this empty)
What happens in the first episode? One or two sentences.
